fato_historico: 1988: Lancang–Gengma earthquakes: At least 730 are killed after two powerful earthquakes rock the China–Myanmar border in Yunnan Province.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you may feel a deep connection to the Earth's resilience today. Much like nature rebuilding after the shifting of tectonic plates, you might find it is a good time to reconstruct your own foundations. Consider how your bold spirit can bring healing and warmth to those around you, turning past shakes into stable new beginnings.
frase_do_dia: Even the strongest ground shifts to make room for something beautiful and new.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of your natural inner wisdom and strength.
conselho: Stand firm in your truth while remaining open to the winds of change.
